invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list (as it is constructed via stream operations on a non-null list).
The input list is accessed without null checks, implying it is expected to be non-null.
The returned list only contains records for which isCurrentLocationKnown() is false.
Filtering elements from hoodieRecords can only decrease or keep the same the size of the result.
Every record in the result must come from the original input hoodieRecords.
